explanation: The overall time complexity is governed by the LQFT Benchmark page and data sorting layers (projects and blog feeds) which perform sorting and comparison operations in O(N log N) time, while standard page views and API operations run in linear O(N) time. Memory complexity is bounded to O(N) because the application holds dataset instances (projects, blog posts, live logs, simulated trees, and chatbot contexts) in both React's local state/Virtual DOM and server-side MongoDB/Redis cache buffers.
